reasons: Novelty pressure: 13.3% of new collections among the 30 most recent need review (watch at >= 10%).

indicators.label: Novelty pressure
indicators.rule: Novelty pressure = share of new collections whose status is needs_review, over all collections and over the 30 most recent by collection date; status from the larger share: watch if >= 10%, retrain if >= 25%.
indicators.evidence: 9 of 192 new collections need review (4.7%); 4 of the 30 most recent by date (13.3%). Status from the larger share (13.3%, among the 30 most recent).

indicators.label: New-class demand
indicators.rule: New-class demand, per analyst class: emerging (labeled in 1 collection) is nominal; recurring (labeled in >= 2 collections, or >= 5 verified-confirmed assignments across >= 2 collections) is watch -- the class exists in the field; the detector cannot learn it without retraining; retrain if recurring and (>= 20 labels, or verified precision < 60% with >= 10 verified) -- labels growing faster than assignments means the representation cannot carry the class.
indicators.evidence: Military fighter: 6 labels in 1 collection, 9 assigned, none verified yet -> emerging.

indicators.label: Detector quality (field)
indicators.rule: Detector quality in the field, from reviewed flagged detections in the latest version's field block: field precision on flagged = (reviewed - not aircraft - bad box) / reviewed; bad-box rate = bad box / reviewed. Fewer than 10 reviewed = insufficient evidence (nominal). Watch if precision < 60% or bad-box rate >= 25%; retrain if precision < 40%.
indicators.evidence: 8 reviewed flagged detections in the latest version's field block -- fewer than 10, so insufficient evidence for a status (nominal by default).

indicators.label: Patch safety
indicators.rule: Patch safety = largest per-class accuracy drop on the labeled control set, v1 -> latest and across any single consecutive version step: nominal if <= 1pp, watch if <= 3pp, retrain if > 3pp (patches are costing validated performance).
indicators.evidence: No per-class drop on the labeled control set across v1 -> v2 (worst change: Medium Civil Transport/Utility 41.3% -> 41.3%).
